name: Aera in the Ink Realm
description:
About This Game

Enter the Ink Realm

Aera in the Ink Realm is a third-person dark fantasy action RPG that combines fast-paced katana combat, martial arts, exploration, and a mysterious story set across corrupted storybook worlds.

After inheriting a long-abandoned ancient library, Aera and her friends discover books connected to another realm. When her friends are pulled into different stories, Aera must enter the Ink Realm, survive its twisted worlds, and uncover the truth hidden inside the library.

Master Fast-Paced Combat

Fight cursed samurai, corrupted knights, ink-born creatures, and powerful bosses using Aera’s katana, martial arts techniques, dodges, counters, and combat abilities.

Switch between precise sword attacks and close-range hand-to-hand combat as you adapt to different enemies and encounters.

Explore Corrupted Storybook Worlds

Travel through dark fantasy realms inspired by ancient legends, ruined kingdoms, cursed dojos, mysterious palaces, and broken fairy tales.

Each world features its own atmosphere, enemies, challenges, and secrets connected to the Ink Realm.

Uncover Aera’s Story

Follow a mysterious glowing manuscript left behind by Aera’s deceased relative. Discover why the library was abandoned, what happened to Aera’s friends, and what force is controlling the Ink Realm.

Features

·         Enter cursed living books and restore broken stories

·         Fast third-person action combat

·         Cinematic boss fights

·         Magical library hub with portals and secrets

·         Five dark fantasy book worlds

·         Story-driven progression

·         Female protagonist

·         Playable demo in development

Aera in the Ink Realm is currently in development. Features, visuals, and content may change before the final release.
short_desc: Enter cursed books, fight broken stories, and rescue five lost friends in a dark fantasy action RPG.
